newsitem.title: FINLAND: CSFB keeps buy on Orion, ups price target.
newsitem.headline: CSFB keeps buy on Orion, ups price target.

text.p: Investment bank Credit Suisse First Boston has repeated its "buy" recommendation and raised its price target on Finnish pharmaceuticals group Orion-yhtyma Oy, CSFB said in a research note received on Friday.
"We reiterate our Buy recommendation and raise our price target to 220 markka," CSFB said in the research note dated May 1.
"The market continues to view Orion as a generic drug firm. We believe that this perception is outdated," CSFB said.
Because of that view Orion's stock traded at a discount to the sector on various multiples, it said.
"Orion continues its transformation into a research driven firm whose return on invested capital exceeds the sector average," CSFB said.
"Orion's drug division and its net investments alone are worth its current market capitalisation.
"Valuing Orion's remaining divisions at modest multiples of sales or EBIT (earnings before interest and tax) provides us with a sum-of-the-parts value of 245-252 markka per share," it said.
